panels.title: First output latency p50 / p90 / p99 (streaming)
panels.description: Time to first byte on a streamed attempt, at three quantiles. p50 is the typical turn; the p90-p99 gap is what the tail costs. Blocking attempts are excluded: their TTFT is the whole call, so mixing them would describe neither. Alerting is on p90 alone (rage rules-smolllm.yml); p50/p99 are here to explain a p90 alert, not to fire one.

panels.title: First-output sample coverage
panels.description: Share of attempts that produced a first-output sample. A p90 only describes the attempts that reached the histogram; below 1.0 it describes a subset, and this panel says how big that subset is.

panels.title: Hang share (7d)

targets.expr: (sum by (alias) (increase(smolllm_attempts_total{outcome="first_output_timeout"}[7d]) or increase(smolllm_attempts_total{outcome=~"error|canceled",phase!="stream"}[7d])) or 0 * sum by (alias) (increase(smolllm_attempts_total[7d]))) / sum by (alias) (increase(smolllm_attempts_total[7d]))

panels.description: Attempts that never produced a first output -- the first-output guard firing, or an error/cancel before the stream started -- as a share of all attempts. Timeouts take no phase clause because a guard timeout is recorded in whichever phase it fired, including stream.
